content.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
content.summary: 1116 ET – Uber had its largest trip volume increase since the post-Covid rebound during 3Q, an acceleration that William Blair analysts say can be attributed to several improvements including global expansion, the grocery and retail segment, and cross-platform conversions.  In the near-term, the ride-hailing company will continue its push toward autonomous vehicles, supported by partnerships with Nvidia and Stellantis.  Uber falls 6.6% despite what the analysts say is a strong quarter and good outlook.
